title: Vancomycin Serum Concentrations in Pediatric Oncology Patients Under Intensive Care
brief_summary: Observational protocol to analyse routine vancomycin serum levels of patients under intensive care and to obtain percentage of patients that achieve therapeutic values.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalized pediatric oncology patients
* Patients under vancomycin treatment
study_population: Pediatric oncology patients on intensive care unit for treatment of infections.
